-- name: ListActiveAccountsFreeDuring
SELECT
    a.id,
    a.name,
    a.email,
    a.created_at
FROM accounts a
WHERE a.status = 'active'
EXCEPT
SELECT
    a.id,
    a.name,
    a.email,
    a.created_at
FROM accounts a
JOIN reservations r ON r.account_id = a.id
WHERE r.during && tstzrange(@from, @to)
ORDER BY name;
